Canadian Federal Byelections Held in British Columbia, Ontario, and Quebec

Voters in three Canadian federal electoral districts participated in byelections on Monday. The ridings were Chicoutimi-Le Fjord in Quebec, and two unnamed ridings in British Columbia and Ontario. Elections Canada issued reminders to voters in Chicoutimi-Le Fjord about the federal nature of the byelection.
